summary: American Mountain ground lookout in Lincoln County, Montana; the FFLA list says gone, firelookout.com says abandoned with a 1930s cab still there; the two sources conflict.

facts.design: Cab with a crow's nest per firelookout.com; classed as a ground lookout by the FFLA list
facts.status_note: The FFLA list marks it Gone. firelookout.com calls the lookout abandoned and says the 1930s cab and crow's nest were still there. The sources conflict, and no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: location at 48.96212, -116.03339 in Lincoln County; ground lookout; marked Gone
the lookout is in the Kootenai National Forest
the lookout is in Lincoln County, Montana
a 1930s cab and crow's nest described as still there
the lookout is described as abandoned

corrections.proposed: abandoned per firelookout.com, which describes the 1930s cab and crow's nest as still there
corrections.why: The firelookout.com page says 'Abandoned.' and does not use the word standing. The record's conflict value does not match the page text.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only, and they conflict on status. The association list calls it a ground lookout, but firelookout.com mentions a crow's nest, which the record cannot reconcile with a ground design; design is left as both descriptions. The firelookout.com page is short and undated, so the 'still there' phrase cannot be dated. No build date, builder, staffing or events with a year were found, so no events are recorded. Record elevation 2008.9 m matches 6,591 ft. A second web search returned only Yaak Mountain lookout rentals, a different lookout. The firelookout.com Montana directory lists only the american.html file, dated 2014, with no further text.
